name: Kuonji Kasumi
source:
A side heroine who is the axis of the entire story in the "Kokoro ..." series. She was killed by Souji. She had an unparalleled beauty and a gentle spirit. She often appears in Souji's dreams, and she becomes a ghost in order to curse him. 

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%82%B3%E3%83%BB%E3%82%B3%E3%83%BB%E3%83%AD%E2%80%A6]Wikipedia[/url].]
